_readme: Copy to config/movie-engagements.json (private, gitignored). A missing file means no confirmations, not an error.
Each entry is a reviewed confirmation of a real screening, typed in from the page at sourceUrl. Nothing here is inferred.
Required: title, theater, format, startDate (YYYY-MM-DD), sourceUrl (https), confirmedAt (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp with zone).
Optional: tmdbId (preferred join key; otherwise the exact title, plus year when given), year, endDate, showtimes, expiresAt, note, allowOtherTheater.
format is one of: IMAX, IMAX 70mm, 70mm, 35mm, Dolby Cinema, Standard.
theater must exactly match a priorityTheaters name in config/movies.json unless allowOtherTheater is true.
showtimes are local date-times with no zone suffix (2031-03-14T19:00). List only showtimes published at sourceUrl; leave the field out when none are published.
Expiry: expiresAt when given, else endDate, else confirmedAt + 21 days. Expired entries drop back to the watchlist and are reported in source health.
Unknown fields are rejected so a typo cannot silently change a run. The entry below is fictional.
